uplink.description: Status report: gang0 open, gang1 closed, battery 3.0 V
uplink._note: Synthetic in-bounds frame derived from the upstream example input (TTN r718lb2 status report). deviceType 69=0x45=R718LB2; reportType 0x01; byte3=30 -> 3.0 V; byte4=1 -> gang0 open; byte5=0 -> gang1 closed. Each gang's state is a channels[] entry (gang0 = Netvox channel 1); expected.data authored to the normalized vocabulary (action.contactState per entry), confirmed against the upstream oracle which decodes Volt=3, status1=1, status2=0. Satisfies contact through the entries.

uplink.description: Status report: gang0 closed, gang1 open, battery 3.6 V
uplink._note: Synthetic in-bounds frame. byte3=36 -> 3.6 V; byte4=0 -> gang0 closed; byte5=1 -> gang1 open. Covers the inverse per-position states from vector 1, so the two entries cannot be transposed unnoticed. Upstream oracle: Volt=3.6, status1=0, status2=1.

uplink.description: Status report: both gangs open, low battery flag set (2.8 V)
uplink._note: Synthetic in-bounds frame exercising the low-battery flag. byte3=156=0x9C -> high bit set (lowBattery true), low 7 bits 0x1C=28 -> 2.8 V; both gangs open. Upstream oracle: Volt='2.8(low battery)', status1=1, status2=1. battery/lowBattery are whole-device readings and stay top-level, outside the channels[] entries.

uplink.description: Status report: low battery (2.8 V) with gang0 closed, gang1 open
uplink._note: Synthetic in-bounds frame combining the low-battery flag with differing per-position states, so a whole-device flag and per-entry states are exercised in one frame. Upstream oracle semantics: Volt '2.8(low battery)', status1 = bytes[4] = 0 -> gang0 closed, status2 = bytes[5] = 1 -> gang1 open.

uplink.description: Startup version report (fPort 6, reportType 0x00) carries no measurement
uplink._note: Upstream example input for the device-info/startup frame. reportType 0x00 carries version/datecode (upstream oracle: SWver=10, HWver=11, Datecode=20200424), not a measurement -> error.

uplink._note: Upstream example input for a ConfigReportRsp on fPort 7; carries no measurement -> error.
